brandbook.motif: Arco continuo de torno unido al borde de una mesa de trabajo. En portada contiene visualmente el encuentro entre manos y barro; en interiores señala la experiencia seleccionada y la continuidad del recorrido. No representa ocho plazas ni otra cantidad que pudiera confundirse con capacidad.

pages.title: Defining
pages.summary: Describe Vuelta as a ceramics workshop, not a spa or object shop. Connect each invitation to materials, a two-hour experience and a clear next action.

examples.text: Conoce tres experiencias de dos horas: primera taza, torno inicial y esmaltes y color.
examples.title: Vuelta · Taller de cerámica

examples.text: Use hands, clay texture and reference pieces. Avoid candles, wellness claims, shopping bags and product-buying language.
examples.title: Editorial focus

pages.title: Vision & Mission
pages.summary: Treat these as proposed communication aims, not established corporate claims. Invite exploration, then make choosing and reviewing a workshop straightforward.

examples.text: Dale forma a tu pausa.
examples.title: Invitation

examples.text: Explora los talleres, elige un turno y revisa tus datos antes de guardar.

pages.title: Brand Values
pages.summary: Express proposed design principles through visible choices: material honesty, clear information and continuity. Do not present invented credentials or service guarantees as values.

examples.text: Label an external cup photograph «Pieza de referencia», never «Hecha en Vuelta».
examples.title: Material honesty

examples.text: Keep «primera taza» visible from selection through review. Preserve entered information when a turn becomes unavailable.
examples.title: Clarity and continuity

pages.title: Tone of Voice
pages.summary: Write public copy in natural Colombian Spanish. Prefer short verbs and concrete nouns. Be warm without therapy language, exaggerated outcomes or invented social proof.

examples.text: Elige tu taller. Consulta los turnos disponibles y continúa con tus datos.
examples.title: Use

examples.text: Do not write «Transforma tu vida», «Cientos de alumnos felices» or «Tu santuario de bienestar».
examples.title: Avoid

examples.text: No pudimos cargar los turnos. Tus datos siguen aquí. Intenta de nuevo.
examples.title: When something fails

pages.title: Logo
pages.summary: Introduce the logo system on Warm Clay. Show the cobalt symbol on a plaster support and set Vuelta separately in live typography; neither element becomes a photograph overlay.

examples.text: Taller de cerámica
examples.title: Vuelta

examples.text: Use one large lockup aligned to the table edge. Leave the remaining clay field open rather than repeating the symbol as wallpaper.
examples.title: Divider placement

pages.title: Logo overview
pages.summary: The system pairs an open circular turn with a horizontal table edge. Use the supplied geometric master for the symbol and preserve the exact name Vuelta.

examples.text: Vuelta — uppercase V, lowercase uelta. Do not change it to VUELTA, Vuelta Studio or Taller Cerámica Vuelta in the logo.
examples.title: Name treatment

examples.text: Use the complete symbol with the name for introductions; use the symbol alone only where Vuelta is already identified.
examples.title: System components

pages.title: Primary logo
pages.summary: Place the symbol left of Vuelta in Bricolage Grotesque 700. Match the visible symbol height to 1.25 times the name’s cap height and separate them by half a cap height.

examples.text: Cobalt symbol + Vuelta on plaster. Keep the name in real typography, not inside the symbol SVG.
examples.title: Header lockup

examples.text: Set «Taller de cerámica» below Vuelta in Source Sans 3 400, aligned with the V rather than the symbol.
examples.title: Descriptor lockup

pages.title: Logo Safezone
pages.summary: Let x equal the symbol’s 14-unit band thickness. Keep at least 2x clear around visible logo geometry; increase to 3x beside photography, buttons or a page edge.

examples.text: At a 40 px symbol canvas, x is 3.5 px. Leave at least 7 px around the lockup and 10.5 px before navigation.
examples.title: Header spacing

examples.text: Keep the Vuelta lockup outside the hands-and-clay crop. The image edge must not enter its 3x photographic safezone.
examples.title: Photographic boundary

pages.title: Color combinations
pages.summary: Prefer cobalt on plaster. On cobalt, clay or charcoal applications, retain the original cobalt symbol on a plaster support; do not recolor individual parts of its geometry.

examples.text: Vuelta in #254DA6 on #F5F0E7. Use the same pairing for navigation and selected workshop labels.
examples.title: Primary pairing

examples.text: On #242B32, set the separate name in plaster and place the complete cobalt symbol on a plaster support with its safezone intact.
examples.title: Dark application

pages.title: Brandmark
pages.summary: The open turn meets a table edge in one continuous band. Preserve the master’s proportions, opening and orientation. It suggests making, not a capacity count or loading spinner.

examples.text: Use the complete symbol at 24 px or larger in interface placements. Do not close its opening or remove the horizontal ending.
examples.title: Small use

examples.text: Place a small arc cue beside «primera taza» and a text label «Seleccionado». Never use eight repeated symbols to represent seats.
examples.title: Selection cue

pages.title: Logo misuse
pages.summary: Do not stretch, rotate, outline, texture or crop the logo. Keep the mark distinct from interface arcs, and do not replace the V in Vuelta with the symbol.

examples.text: No cracked texture, bevel or ceramic glaze effect inside the Vuelta symbol. Material character belongs in photography.
examples.title: Avoid simulated clay

examples.text: Do not bend Vuelta around the arc, rotate it like a wheel or place the name inside a boxed initial.
examples.title: Avoid unstable lockups

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use Bricolage Grotesque for expressive headings and Source Sans 3 for reading and tasks. Introduce the pair with one large invitation, not a directory of font names.

examples.text: Elige una experiencia de dos horas con barro, torno o color.
examples.title: Dale forma a tu pausa.

examples.text: Place the headline above one table-edge rule. Keep supporting copy short and left-aligned.
examples.title: Divider rhythm

pages.title: Typography overview
pages.summary: Keep a two-family system. Bricolage establishes personality; Source Sans keeps prices, schedules and forms calm and legible. Supplied files cover weights 400, 500, 600 and 700.

examples.text: Compara los talleres y elige el que quieres explorar.
examples.title: Tres maneras de empezar

examples.text: Use Bricolage for the headline and workshop names. Use Source Sans for duration, price, controls and explanatory copy.
examples.title: Family roles

pages.title: Primary typeface
pages.summary: Set Bricolage Grotesque headings in sentence case at 600–700. Preserve its humanist character with normal-width letters and restrained line breaks; never substitute a decorative serif.

examples.text: Primera taza, torno inicial o esmaltes y color. Encuentra tu punto de partida.
examples.title: Una mesa, tres comienzos.

examples.text: Use 700 for the main invitation and 600 for workshop headings. Keep short names together instead of breaking «primera taza» across lines.
examples.title: Headline setting

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use upright 700 for major headings, 600 for subheads and step labels, and 400 for body copy. Reserve 500 for quiet emphasis. Do not synthesize bold or introduce an unsupported italic.

examples.text: Comprueba el taller, el turno, las personas y tus datos de contacto.
examples.title: Revisa antes de guardar

examples.text: Bricolage 700: «Revisión». Source Sans 600: «Tus datos». Source Sans 400: «Todavía no se ha guardado una reserva».
examples.title: Weight specimen

pages.title: Supporting type
pages.summary: Set Source Sans 3 body copy and fields at 16/24 px. Use visible labels rather than placeholders alone, and keep dates, contact details and reservation codes easy to scan.

examples.text: Nombre, email y teléfono. Puedes añadir una nota opcional antes de revisar.
examples.title: Tus datos

examples.text: Use 14/20 px at 600 for step labels and at least 12/18 px for photo credits. Field labels remain 16 px.
examples.title: Small-text floor

pages.title: Hierarchy
pages.summary: Set hero type at 76/80 desktop, 52/56 tablet and 40/42 mobile. Interior titles use 40/44, reducing to 28/32 on mobile. Keep body text at 16/24.

examples.text: Elige una fecha y consulta los comienzos disponibles.
examples.title: Taller y turno

examples.text: On booking screens, place title, current step, chosen workshop and next available turn before supporting explanations.
examples.title: Reading order

pages.title: Layouts
pages.summary: Compose a shared workshop table, not identical cards. Align image, selection and controls to one horizontal edge. Use 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48 and 64 px spacing.

examples.text: Give the hands photograph the widest area. Place «Reservar ahora» in its own lower margin; vary reference-image sizes across the shared surface.
examples.title: Desktop table

examples.text: At 390×600, budget about 56 px for header, 28 for notice, 40 for steps and 76 for context. Expose option, date and next turn without autofocus.
examples.title: Mobile arrival

pages.title: Colors
pages.summary: Use plaster as the working surface, cobalt as structure and clay as material warmth. Charcoal carries reading text; Quiet Earth supports secondary information.

examples.text: Set «Dale forma a tu pausa.» in cobalt over plaster. Let the real clay in the photograph provide texture rather than adding beige effects.
examples.title: A cobalt-led workshop

pages.title: Colors overview
pages.summary: Preserve all five palette values. Keep functional selection cobalt, reading text charcoal and clay surfaces selective so the identity does not drift toward a spa aesthetic.

examples.text: Workshop Plaster #F5F0E7: background. Warm Clay #C65D42: secondary surface and material accent.
examples.title: Ground and surface

examples.text: Turning Cobalt #254DA6: accent. Kiln Charcoal #242B32: text. Quiet Earth #625B55: muted copy.
examples.title: Action and reading

examples.text: Use plaster text on cobalt controls. Keep small text off clay surfaces; place it on a plaster inset instead.
examples.title: Accessible pairing

pages.title: Using Tints
pages.summary: Keep logo and primary controls at full color. Restrict cobalt tints to quiet supporting areas over plaster; do not create new named brand colors or reduce text opacity.

examples.text: A 10% cobalt overlay on plaster may sit behind «Taller seleccionado». Keep its label and outline solid cobalt.
examples.title: Selection surface

examples.text: Show «17:00 · Sin cupo» with a clear label and muted text. A pale fill alone must not communicate unavailability.
examples.title: Unavailable turn

pages.title: Graphic Elements
pages.summary: Extend the identity with table-edge rules and open arcs, not scattered circles. Animate only explicit selection or validated progress, for 160–220 ms without moving the page.

examples.text: When «torno inicial» is chosen, move the supporting arc toward its reference and retain the visible workshop name.
examples.title: Selection arc

examples.text: Change the arc and step state immediately. Keep «Tus datos» and visible focus; remove animated drawing and translation.
examples.title: Reduced motion

pages.title: Icons
pages.summary: Use simple 24 px line icons with consistent 2 px strokes. Pair unfamiliar actions with text, preserve 44 px targets and avoid borrowing decorative pottery pictograms for navigation.

examples.text: Pair a calendar with «Fecha» and a people icon with «Asistentes». Keep the number 1–4 visible in its control.
examples.title: Calendar and people

examples.text: Use «Cancelar reserva» beside its icon. Do not communicate a destructive action through coral color or a trash symbol alone.
examples.title: Cancellation

pages.title: Photography
pages.summary: Use sharp documentary photographs with intact texture. The supplied hands image introduces process; separately licensed piece references explain workshops. Never present external work as Vuelta products.

examples.text: Foto representativa tomada en Egipto: Violinistman, CC BY 4.0, Wikimedia Commons. Recorte de encuadre; no muestra el local de Vuelta.
examples.title: Main image credit

examples.text: Keep the working hands and clay visible, with no text over them. Use a compact, subject-preserving context image in booking.
examples.title: Crop and placement

examples.text: Label licensed cup, turned-piece and glaze images «Pieza de referencia». If an image is unavailable, recompose with text rather than fabricate it.
examples.title: Reference coverage

pages.title: Moodboard
pages.summary: Choose the editorial workshop table over a full-bleed cobalt poster or sample-led notebook. Combine documentary hands, cobalt structure, humanist type and asymmetrical reference arrangements.

examples.text: Sharp clay texture, a shared plaster plane, one cobalt table edge and workshop names close to their reference photographs.
examples.title: Keep

examples.text: Spa imagery, cream-and-serif styling, identical cards, decorative numbers, fake testimonials and isolated product cutouts.
examples.title: Leave out

pages.title: Applications
pages.summary: Label every application as a design study. Carry the table edge, cobalt hierarchy and humanist typography into each format without suggesting an account, shop or service that is not planned.

examples.text: Use «Design study» in presentation captions, outside the public-facing artwork. Do not place production notes in the interface.

pages.summary: Design study: alternate process, reference and practical information posts. Use one shared edge across a carousel, but vary image scale rather than repeating a three-card template.

examples.text: Keep credits accessible in the caption. A representative glaze photograph must not be described as a result made in Vuelta.

pages.title: Posters
pages.summary: Design study: build a poster from one large headline, documentary image and clear lower information strip. Keep the action outside the hands and the schedule legible at reading distance.

pages.title: T shirts and totes
pages.summary: Design study: use a single cobalt print on a plaster-colored textile. Place the small complete lockup at the chest or upper bag edge; avoid merchandise pricing or purchase cues.

examples.text: Keep the symbol separate from the phrase. Allow a broad unprinted area so the object feels like workshop equipment, not a promotional collage.
examples.title: Print arrangement

pages.title: Piece wrapping
pages.summary: Design study: adapt takeaway packaging to a ceramic-piece wrap. Use a plaster band with cobalt identity and a small clay panel; do not imply collection, shipping or included take-home pieces.

examples.text: Vuelta · Taller de cerámica
examples.title: Barro, forma y color.

examples.text: Keep the logo on a flat, visible band. Place «Pieza de referencia» on display mockups rather than inventing product specifications or care guarantees.

pages.title: Workshop arrival
pages.summary: Design study: replace pickup instructions with conceptual workshop-location information. Show neighborhood, city, days and start times without an address, real map pin or invented directions.

examples.text: Ubicación conceptual. Martes a domingo, comienzos 10:00, 14:00 y 17:00. Cada experiencia dura 2 h.
examples.title: Laureles, Medellín

examples.text: Set the location above the cobalt table edge and the schedule below it. Do not draw a map that implies a real Vuelta venue.

pages.title: Booking controls
pages.summary: Design study: /reservar starts with workshop, date, 1–4 attendees and live turns. Use cobalt selection, visible labels and normal page scroll; never cover controls with a floating action.

examples.text: Elige una fecha y de 1 a 4 asistentes. Consulta los turnos disponibles antes de continuar.
examples.title: Taller y turno

examples.text: Show server availability for Tuesday–Sunday at 10:00, 14:00 and 17:00, America/Bogota. Capacity is 8 per workshop, date and turn.

examples.text: No pudimos consultar la disponibilidad. Intenta de nuevo. Do not substitute invented places or offer local-only booking.

pages.title: Reservation record
pages.summary: Design study: /revision presents one specification, not a checkout receipt. /confirmacion shows success only after server confirmation, with the saved code and state rather than a generic celebratory check.

examples.text: Revisa tus datos. Todavía no hay una reserva guardada ni un cupo bloqueado.
examples.title: Antes de guardar

examples.text: Consulta el código, el estado y los datos confirmados. No se envían mensajes ni se procesan pagos.

examples.text: Show workshop, date, time, attendees, name, email, phone and optional notes. Display the actual saved code; never prefill a fictional success record.

pages.title: Reservation reference card
pages.summary: Design study: replace a rewards card with a private reservation reference. Keep code, state and workshop together; do not invent points, stamps, membership tiers or discounts.

examples.text: Abre Mis reservas para consultar el taller, la fecha, el turno y el estado guardado.
examples.title: Tu reserva, a mano.

examples.text: Use the card only inside the owner’s session. Do not place contact details, private identifiers or reservation codes in public artwork.
examples.title: Privacy rule

pages.title: Workshop sign
pages.summary: Design study: adapt restaurant signage to a ceramics workshop. Use a cobalt name on plaster with generous clearspace and a smaller descriptor; the mockup must not imply an existing venue.

examples.text: Taller de cerámica
examples.title: Vuelta

examples.text: Use the complete horizontal lockup with 3x clearance from the sign edge. Keep the descriptor subordinate and omit invented street numbers.
examples.title: Sign proportions

pages.title: Booking website
pages.summary: Design study: give every route the same editorial table system. Move from discovery to selection, review, server confirmation and private records; do not turn interiors into a generic dashboard.

examples.text: primera taza · 90.000 COP; torno inicial · 120.000 COP; esmaltes y color · 75.000 COP. Todas duran 2 h. Precios de ejemplo.

examples.text: Inicio / → Talleres /talleres → /reservar → /revision → /confirmacion. Preserve the chosen workshop and use «Guardar reserva» only after review.

examples.text: /mis-reservas offers «Recargar» and «Abrir detalle» at /reserva. Keep records private, preserve input on errors and never replace Turso with simulated success.
examples.title: Mis reservas

pages.title: Favicon
pages.summary: Design study: derive the favicon and app icons from the complete geometric master. Use a plaster support, preserve the open turn and keep the separate Vuelta name out of tiny icons.

examples.text: Taller de cerámica · Inicio
examples.title: Vuelta — Dale forma a tu pausa.

examples.text: Export the same geometry for 16 and 32 px browser icons. Do not substitute a starter icon, letter V or newly drawn miniature mark.

pages.title: Stationery
pages.summary: Design study: align the lockup, document heading and body to one left edge. Use a cobalt rule as the table boundary and leave generous plaster space for readable workshop notes.

examples.text: Barro, forma y color. Un espacio para observar el proceso.
examples.title: Notas de taller

examples.text: Use Bricolage 600 for the heading and Source Sans 400 for notes. Keep the footer free of invented addresses, registration numbers or staff names.

pages.title: Business cards
pages.summary: Design study: make a workshop introduction card, not a fictional employee card. Put Vuelta and its invitation on the front, with conceptual location and workshop discovery on the reverse.

pages.title: Invitation card
pages.summary: Design study: adapt the gift-card format into a non-redeemable workshop invitation. Do not add a stored value, redemption code, purchase action or booking entitlement.

examples.text: Place the invitation above a cobalt edge and the workshop names below. No amount box, voucher number or «Canjear» control.

pages.title: Packaging seal
pages.summary: Design study: use a plaster seal with the complete cobalt symbol. Keep the name separately typeset when space allows; never turn the seal into a quality certification or product guarantee.

examples.text: Center the full mark with 2x clearspace. Keep it away from folds and omit claims such as «Hecho en Medellín» or «Calidad certificada».

pages.title: Customer support
pages.summary: Design study: help through clear inline states and safe actions, not invented support channels. Preserve input, distinguish empty from error and confirm cancellation before changing the saved state.

brandbook.voice: Español cercano, concreto y colombiano sin caricaturas. Hablar de manos, barro, tiempo y exploración; orientar con verbos claros. Mantener «Dale forma a tu pausa.» como titular. Sin promesas terapéuticas, reseñas inventadas, credenciales ni jerga técnica en la experiencia pública.
brandbook.positioning: Identidad original propuesta para un taller ficticio de cerámica en Laureles, Medellín. Una invitación cercana a hacer una pausa de dos horas con barro, torno y color. Experiencias, ubicación y precios de ejemplo, con reservas de demostración realmente guardadas.
